about_the_game:
Bendy and the Ink Machine - Official Soundtrack

Relive the eerie, ink-drenched world of Bendy and the Ink Machine with this beautifully remastered official soundtrack, featuring 19 haunting tracks composed by theMeatly. Dive into the nostalgic 1930s cartoon-inspired horror through its atmospheric ambiences, dark tracks, and sinister melodies that capture the game's twisted studio adventure. From the chilling opener "Sketches" to the climactic "Drawn To Darkness" each piece immerses you in Joey Drew Studios' dark secrets.

Includes high-quality MP3 and lossless WAV formats for the ultimate listening experience. Perfect for fans craving that inky thrill beyond the game!
